title: Inverse Galois A5: Sylvester Matrix Rows 5-8 for Resultant
description: Computes Sylvester matrix rows 5-8 for the resultant of q = X⁵ − 5X⁴ + 10X³ − 10X² + 25X − 5 and its derivative. Supporting module for InverseGaloisA5Resultant.lean. 8 theorems, 0 sorries, 0 axioms.

overview.historicalContext: The resultant of f and f' is the determinant of the Sylvester matrix. For the polynomial q = X⁵ − 5X⁴ + ... − 5 with Galois group A₅, computing the resultant proves q is square-free (distinct roots).
overview.problemStatement: Verify rows 5-8 of the 9×9 Sylvester matrix for the resultant of q and q', using fin_cases and decide.
overview.proofStrategy: Each theorem r5, r6, r7, r8 states that the k-th row of the sylvester matrix matches the precomputed sylvM matrix. Proved by fin_cases j ∧ simp computation using Lean's coeff extraction.
keyInsights: **Sylvester matrix**: for deg(f) = m and deg(g) = n, the Sylvester matrix has m+n rows — here 5+4=9 rows for q and q'.
**Computational verification**: each row is verified by Lean's kernel — the decide tactic over Fin 9 checks all 9 entries mechanically.
**Resultant and discriminant**: Res(q, q') = (−1)^(n(n-1)/2) · leading_coeff^(n-m) · Disc(q). Non-zero resultant ↔ q square-free ↔ distinct roots.
